strikes.name: flick_rise
strikes.look: A flick of the open palm up under the chin from a loose stand, the wrist snapping it, the feet planted and the arm lowering at once.
strikes.orig: a flick of the open palm up under the chin from a loose stand, the wrist snapping it, the feet planted and the arm lowering at once

strikes.name: scythe_sweep
strikes.look: The edge of the foot scythed out low across the shins from a crouch, one hand down for the balance.
strikes.orig: the edge of the foot scythed out low across the shins from a crouch, one hand down for the balance

strikes.name: heel_thrust
strikes.look: The heel of the palm driven straight into the belly from the shoulder, the weight going in behind it.
strikes.orig: the heel of the palm driven straight into the belly from the shoulder, the weight going in behind it

strikes.name: wheel_blade
strikes.look: A blade hand swung out wide across the chest in a turn of the whole body, the chest opening away as it pushes past.
strikes.orig: a blade hand swung out wide across the chest in a turn of the whole body, the chest opening away as it pushes past

strikes.name: lifting_heave
strikes.look: Sunk low with the palm under him, then the heel of the palm heaved up into the chest and the whole body rising behind it.
strikes.orig: sunk low with the palm under him, then the heel of the palm heaved up into the chest and the whole body rising behind it

strikes.name: plunge_blade
strikes.look: Tall on the rear foot with the blade hand cocked beside the head, the elbow bent and back, then brought down onto the chest in one stroke and lowered at once.
strikes.orig: tall on the rear foot with the blade hand cocked beside the head, the elbow bent and back, then brought down onto the chest in one stroke and lowered at once

strikes.name: drive_palm
strikes.look: Side-on with the weight back and the palm at the shoulder, then the heel of the palm driven into the chest with a full lunge behind it.
strikes.orig: side-on with the weight back and the palm at the shoulder, then the heel of the palm driven into the chest with a full lunge behind it

strikes.name: turning_edge
strikes.look: Wound right round with his back half to him, then the edge of the foot swung through in a full turn that carries the rival past.
strikes.orig: wound right round with his back half to him, then the edge of the foot swung through in a full turn that carries the rival past

strikes.name: spike_heel
strikes.look: In the air: the knee drawn up, then the heel stabbed straight down onto the chest of the rival below, the hands open and out for the balance.
